rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for object pronouns, objects of prepositions, and standalone or appositional “me.”

example.jyutping: keoi5 bei2 zo2 ngo5 bun2 syu1

rows.note: Use this when the action is done for oneself, as in the reflexive-beneficiary sense of “me.”

example.english: I bought a cup of coffee for me to drink.
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 bui1 gaa3 fe1 bei2 zi6 gei2 jam2
